digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, prerequisite-consistency criterion, production batch runner
propositions: Focused prerequisite consistency reviews must isolate general finder/verifier/coach requests from prerequisite material through a sole preloaded relation snapshot
Prerequisite batching must maintain stable lexicographic order, never split subject or prerequisite plan text, and independently reshape general and focused verification index domains
Finding identity encoding for prerequisites uses length-prefixed UTF-8 fields (version, text, criteria, ID) with SHA-256, while non-prerequisite findings preserve existing pipe-delimited encoding

Any indeterminate prerequisite coverage record forces top-level unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict, while retained DET blockers remain visible in blocking array and prerequisite_indeterminate=true in coverage flag

Singleton focused finder must achieve recall≥0.90, false-acceptance≤0.10, coverage=1.00, attribution-error=0.00; packed recall must not regress below singleton baseline while maintaining absolute floors

Focused verifier context-limit recovery splits oversized records' finding tuples (not plan text) recursively, preserves original_index through splits, and escalates single findings to largest window before emitting evaluation-error
